headline: Mind and body are connected—each influences the other in continuous feedback loops
universal_truth: You can't separate mind and body; change one and you change the other; they're one system
fun_facts: Smiling actually makes you feel happier—even a forced smile shifts mood
Physical posture affects confidence levels—stand tall to feel more confident
Gut bacteria influence brain chemistry—your microbiome affects your mood
discussion_questions: How does your body state affect your mental state?
How do your thoughts affect your physical feelings?
What feedback loops exist between your mind and body?

hook.script: Feel anxious? Your heart races, muscles tense, breathing quickens. Feel depressed? Your body slouches, energy drains, movements slow. Mind and body aren't separate—they're one system influencing each other constantly.

cliff.script: We often treat mind and body as separate. But they're deeply connected. What does this mean practically?

options.text: Mind and body are one system—changing physical state changes mental state and vice versa; you can use either door to influence the whole system
options.response: Yes. Feeling anxious? Change your breathing, and your mind calms. Stuck mentally? Move your body, and thinking shifts. Two doors to the same room. Use whichever is accessible.
The brain influences the body, but the body also influences the brain—it's bidirectional...

fact1.title: Bidirectional Influence
fact1.script: Brain affects body: anxiety creates tension. Body affects brain: tension creates anxiety. The influence runs both ways. You can intervene from either direction.

fact2.title: Physical Backdoor
fact2.script: Can't change your thoughts? Change your body. Exercise lifts mood. Power poses increase confidence. Deep breathing reduces anxiety. The body provides access to the mind.

fact3.title: Mental Backdoor
fact3.script: Can't change your body? Change your mind. Visualization improves physical performance. Reframing reduces physical stress responses. Mental training has physical effects.

wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: You can't separate mind and body. Change one and you change the other. They're one system with two doors.

outro.script: That's Day 307. Tomorrow, we'll explore how fast you can respond—reaction time. Until then, notice mind-body connections in your experience.

growTrack.title: Mind-Body Mapping - What Connections Do You Notice?
growTrack.activity: When you feel stressed, what happens in your body? When you're tired physically, what happens to your mood? Map your mind-body connections. Which door is easier to access when you need change?
